name: Diana Stanley
title: The Redeemed Cultist
ability:
Diana Stanley gets +1 [willpower] for each card beneath her.
[reaction] After a card you own cancels or ignores a card effect or game effect, if there are fewer than 5 cards beneath Diana Stanley: Place that card facedown beneath her. Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may choose a card beneath Diana Stanley and add it to your hand.
ability_cn:
黛安娜·史丹利底下每有1张卡牌，获得+1[willpower]。
[reaction]在你拥有的一张卡牌取消或忽略一个卡牌效果或游戏效果后，如果黛安娜·史丹利底下的卡牌张数少于5：将该卡牌正面朝下放在她底下。抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。(每阶段限制1次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以选择黛安娜·史丹利底下的一张卡牌加入手牌。
elder_sign: [elder_sign] effect: +2. You may choose a card beneath Diana Stanley and add it to your hand.
elder_sign_cn: [elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以选择黛安娜·史丹利底下的一张卡牌加入手牌。
back_text: Deck Size: 35. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Twilight Blade, Dark Insight, Terrible Secret, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Setup: You begin each game with Dark Insight as an additional card in your opening hand.
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：35。 牌组构建选项：潜修者([mystic])等级0-5，守卫者([guardian])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：银暮匕首、黑暗洞察、可怕的秘密、1张随机基础弱点。 额外设置：每场游戏开始时，你的起始手牌中额外有1张黑暗洞察。
